subject: Mathematics

source.topic: Numbers, operations and relationships: Counting (integrated with number patterns and mental maths)
source.subtopic: Count forwards and backwards in 10s, 5s and 2s from any multiple within the same ranges; use the relationship between + and -; emphasise more than, less than; ascending and descending order

show.line: Counting in tens is fast! Ten, twenty, thirty, forty. In fives: five, ten, fifteen. In twos: two, four, six.

rounds.prompt: Count in tens. Ten, twenty, thirty. What comes next?
Count in twos. Two, four, six. What comes next?
Count in fives. Five, ten, fifteen. What comes next?
Count the fingers on these hands in fives. How many fingers?
rounds.praise: Twenty fingers! Five, ten, fifteen, twenty.

rounds.prompt: Count the socks in twos. Two, four, six. How many socks? Say it.
Count backwards in tens. Sixty, fifty, forty. What comes next?

hints: Say the counting song out loud. Then say the next one.
In tens the last digit stays the same. Ten, twenty, thirty.

beat_the_tutor.setup: My turn! I will count in fives.
beat_the_tutor.win_line: You caught me! Five, ten, fifteen, twenty. Sixteen is counting in ones.
beat_the_tutor.gentle_line: Let's count in fives together. Five, ten, fifteen, twenty!

parent_line: Can count in tens, fives and twos.
